executionArgs.additionalInstruction:
Test the following flow in the application:
1. Login with admin credentials (admin@unefa.edu / admin123)
2. Navigate to Students page (/students) and register a new student with: CI=V-25000001, name="ESTUDIANTE PRUEBA", career selection
3. Navigate to Tutors page (/tutors) and register a new tutor with: CI=V-30000001, name="TUTOR PRUEBA", career assignment
4. Navigate to Institutions page (/institutions), create new institution with RIF=J-00000001, add a responsible
5. Navigate to PreEnrollment page (/pre-enrollment) and create pre-enrollment for the test student
6. Navigate to Enrollment page (/enrollment) and create enrollment for the test student

Focus on verifying:
- Each "Agregar Nueva Carrera" button appears and works in Enrollment page
- The create/modals work correctly
- No console errors during these operations
